newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees record '96 grain output in provinces.
newsitem.headline: China sees record '96 grain output in provinces.

text.p: Record harvests are expected in three of China's main grain producing provinces in 1996, official media said on Wednesday.

Output in southwestern Sichuan province, one of China's main bread baskets, was expected to total a record 45.8 million tonnes, a rise of 750,000 tonnes over 1995, Xinhua news agency quoted a provincial official as saying.
Eastern Jiangsu province was expected to reap a record 34 million tonnes of grain, a rise of 500,000 tonnes compared with the previous record in 1994, Xinhua said, quoting officials.
It said provincial officials attributed the record forecast to expanded acreage under grain in 1996.

A record output in excess of 16 million tonnes was expected in the northeastern province of Liaoning in 1996 despite natural disasters, the China Securities newspaper quoted agricultural experts as saying.
China has said it expects a harvest of 475 million tonnes of grain for the year, up from a record 466 million last year.
